visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt and a smartwatch sits in an ergonomic chair in an office. He is opening a cardboard box labeled with 'Red Bull' graphics, pulling out a bright pink inner box. The background features gray horizontal blinds and a professional condenser microphone. (2) He unboxes a wooden Kendama toy with a red ball. He examines the ball's texture and the wooden handle closely, looking intrigued. He attempts a basic swing of the ball while seated. (3) He stands up in front of a gray, textured concrete-style wall to attempt a challenge. He repeatedly tosses the red ball, trying to land it on the wooden spike or cups. His facial expressions show intense concentration and mild frustration as he fails several times. (4) He successfully catches the ball on one of the side cups. He stops moving, looks at the camera with a proud smile, and gestures toward the toy with his free hand. (5) A close-up shot of the man's face as he talks enthusiastically, showing clear joy and excitement. (6) A different man with medium-length black hair and a black t-shirt appears in a brightly lit showroom with tall display shelves containing various decorative items. He holds the same Kendama and performs several complex, fluid tricks, catching the ball on the spike and alternating cups without missing. He smiles confidently at the camera. (7) The first man returns to the office setting, holding the Kendama and looking into the camera as if making an announcement. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is a man with short black hair wearing a casual black t-shirt and a black smartwatch. The second character has longer black hair and is also wearing a black t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The first location is a modern office with dark blinds, a professional microphone setup, and a window view of city buildings. The second location is a spacious indoor area with sleek gray walls and large, minimalist shelves displaying toys and trinkets.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo synth-pop BGM begins. A male voice speaks with high energy and an excited tone. The sound of cardboard rustling is audible. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the speaker unboxes the item. His voice pitch rises as he identifies the gift. (3) A sequence of rhythmic wooden impact 'clicks' begins as the Kendama ball hits the wooden handle. The speaker's voice exhibits vocal effort and short pauses corresponding to his physical movements. (4) Multiple 'clack' SFX occur in rapid succession, representing failed attempts. The speaker mumbles with a comedic, self-deprecating tone. (5) A successful, resonant 'click' sound is followed by a loud, celebratory vocal exclamation and light background laughter from another person. (6) A second male voice enters, sounding calm and confident. A series of extremely fast, precise 'click-clack' impact sounds occur, signifying professional-level Kendama play. (7) Both voices engage in a friendly dialogue with high arousal and positive valence. The BGM maintains its steady electronic beat before a final 'ding' SFX and fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Unboxing -> Personal Struggle -> Employee Showcase -> Giveaway Announcement
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video showcases a promotional Kendama received from Red Bull. It humorously contrasts the creator's lack of skill with the unexpected expertise of his employee, turning a simple product unboxing into an entertaining character reveal and a fan giveaway.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator unboxes a branded 'Red Bull' product and mentions it is a 'public relations gift' (公關品), while showing the brand logo clearly.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and variety-show style captions to create a lighthearted atmosphere. The pivot from the host's failure to the employee's skill is the core comedic hook.
